newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine newsman begs for life on tape - reports.
newsitem.headline: Argentine newsman begs for life on tape - reports.

text.p: A secret witness in the investigation into the murder of an Argentine news photographer has presented an audiotape of Jose Luis Cabezas pleading for his life, local news agencies reported on Wednesday.

The witness accused police of killing Cabezas and said one of the murderers made the tape because he wanted to gloat over the sound of the 35-year-old father of three begging for mercy, according to the DyN and Telam news agencies, which quoted judicial sources.
A voice on the tape reportedly handed over to two state prosecutors pleads: "Please don't kill me."
The witness said two policemen killed Cabezas on the orders of a former police inspector.

Prosecutor Maria Brignoles de Nazar told the private DyN news agency that it was still not possible to verify the witness' statement, but added, "It seems credible because (the witness) gave a lot of information, as well as names."
She told DyN the witness came forward at the request of a police officer linked to the crime who had repented the killing.

A former Buenos Aires province policeman and five civilians have been arrested in the investigation since Cabezas' body was found in his burned car in a field near the beach resort of Pinamar on Jan. 25. Cabezas had been handcuffed, tortured and shot in the head before being doused with fuel and set on fire.
Cabezas' murder awakened dark memories of many similar killings during the political violence that tore Argentina apart in the 1970s.

He had been covering the summer vacation season at Pinamar -- a favourite destination of Argentina's rich and powerful -- for controversial news magazine Noticias. Renegade members of the Buenos Aires province police force have from the start been widely suspected of killing Cabezas to protect illegal rackets.
The uproar over the murder led Buenos Aires Gov. Eduardo Duhalde to begin a purge of his police force and warned all 48,00 members he was prepared to fire them.
